episode_law.anchor: cluster anchor = earliest start session; residual ticker = smallest ticker among anchor-session starts
episode_law.cutoff: NYSE close at or after max(system_observed_at, provider_observed_at); label starts strictly after it
episode_law.effective_n: distinct issuer episodes after issuer overlap clustering (starts <= 20 sessions apart chain)
episode_law.identity: issuer + metric + horizon/fiscal period (q|y, period_end) + episode-start NYSE session
episode_law.primary_variant: S: a start needs an observed 20-session quiet (first observed change only after > 20 observed sessions of the series, or a gap > 20 sessions since the previous change)
episode_law.sensitivity_variant: L: left-censored first changes count; violates the preregistered 20-quiet-session law
